text: 促使一些女子卖淫的客观因素
en: Objective factors that drive some women into prostitution

text: 卖淫动机的产生也有一些外在的客观因素
en: The emergence of motives for prostitution also has some external, objective factors

text: 1 .社会分工分配不合理因素
en: 1. Factors of irrational social division of labour and distribution

text: 在倡导劳动致富的今天, 个人收入差距拉大, 由于社会分工和分配有些不合理的因素存在, 劳动与
en: In today's climate that advocates getting rich through labour, the income gap between individuals has widened; because of certain irrational factors in the social division of labour and distribution, a dislocation arises between labour and

text: 报酬产生错位, 加上高消费的刺激和社会上出现的一些腐败现象, 致使一些人靠不正当的手段去致富。
en: reward, coupled with the stimulation of high consumption and some corrupt phenomena in society, causing some people to grow rich through improper means.

text: 卖淫女子由于懒惰、好逸恶劳, 自然缺少竞争能力,又缺乏道德羞耻感, 不懂得自强自立自重自爱, 在这种风气的感染下受卖淫能赚更多钱的意念驱使, 走上邪路, 卖淫现象便应运而生。
en: Prostituted women, being lazy and averse to work, naturally lack competitiveness; they also lack a sense of moral shame and do not understand self-reliance, self-respect and self-love. Infected by this ethos and driven by the notion that prostitution earns more money, they go down the wrong path, and the phenomenon of prostitution thus arises.

text: 在我们所调查的卖淫主要原因一题中, 回答这是最容易赚钱的方式的有32 人, 占73. 3% ; 没有富裕的生活的43 人, 占9 . 8 % ; 不能维持基本生活的3 2 人, 占7 . 3% ; 没有别的谋生手段的5 人, 占1.1%。
en: Among the respondents in our survey to the question of the main reason for prostitution, 32 people (73.3%) answered that it was the easiest way to make money; 43 people (9.8%) lacked a wealthy life; 32 people (7.3%) could not maintain a basic living; and 5 people (1.1%) had no other means of livelihood.
Total 25.5%.

text: 2 .现代婚恋和家庭中存在的问题
en: 2. Problems existing in modern marriage, love and the family

text: 在卖淫主要原因中因得不到家庭和父母温暖的6,1 人,占14 . 6% ; 丈夫工作忙关心不够的25 人, 占5 . 7% ; 丈夫有外遇30 人,占6.8 % ; 夫妻关系不好33 人,占7.5 % ; 夫妻性生活不谐调, 满足不了性要求的10 人, 占2.3%。
en: Among the main reasons for prostitution, 6.1 people (14.6%) cited lack of family and parental warmth; 25 people (5.7%) had husbands too busy at work and inattentive; 30 people (6.8%) had husbands with affairs; 33 people (7.5%) had poor marital relations; and 10 people (2.3%) had discordant marital sex lives that failed to satisfy sexual needs.
Total 36.9%.

text: 现代生活的紧张、节奏加快、现代人对家庭生活的追求使家庭无可避免地面临: ① 感情间题, 如第三者插足和婚外恋;②家务问题; ③ 子女教育问题; ① 赡养老人问题等,产生不可避免的家庭矛盾和冲突。
en: The tension of modern life, the quickening pace, and modern people's pursuit of family life make the family inevitably face: ① emotional problems such as third-party interference and extramarital affairs; ② housework problems; ③ children's education; ① supporting the elderly — producing unavoidable family contradictions and conflicts.

text: 如果不注意调适,裂痕会越来越大, 导致家庭的破裂, 给社会造成不安定因素。
en: If one does not pay attention to adjustment, the rift will grow ever larger, leading to family breakdown and creating destabilising factors for society.

text: 卖淫原因中因恋爱被人玩弄而卖淫的有9 人,占2 2 . 6 % 。
en: Among the reasons for prostitution, 9 people (22.6%) prostituted after being toyed with in love.

text: 由此看来, 女子卖淫问题是恋爱婚姻家庭的一系列问题在社会中的反映, 以致成为影响社会治安和风气的社会问题。
en: Thus it can be seen that the problem of women's prostitution is a reflection in society of a series of problems in love, marriage and the family, such that it becomes a social problem affecting public order and moral climate.
